description: Done-when shapes the issue lane cannot finish, beside the built-in kinds in intake admission (.github/scripts/intake-triage/admit.mjs, unrunnableCriteria). Each `rules` row is {kind, match, unless}: `match` and `unless` are JavaScript regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against one task-list item's text; an item `match` finds and `unless` (null for none) does not is a done-when item the lane cannot perform, and its refusal names `kind`. Every row routes as the built-in host kinds do: the host queue (`host-run`), or the owner when an `eval` item also names a billing account. The built-in kinds are tried first and an item takes the first kind that matches. A row adds only what the built-in kinds miss, so `unless` keeps the shapes they leave with the lane (a no-spend harness command, a comment a script posts, a host named in prose). A file that does not read or parse, an empty `rules`, a row without a kind or `match`, or a pattern that does not compile throws out of admission, so no issue is admitted on a guess. `measured` records each row's score so a re-score stays comparable: host-run issues against lane-delivered controls, an issue counting when any of its done-when items matches.

measured.sets: 154 host-run issues (an outcome=host-run lane comment, or a host-run or cannot-perform admission refusal) and 147 controls (closed by a merged work-resolve-issue lane pull request, without host-run); 52 + 28 read in full to write the patterns, 102 + 119 hold-out read from the body only
measured.fields: builtin: the built-in kinds alone; union: the built-in kinds and these rows; host_only_stops: the 52-issue sample's lane `host-only` stops flagged; host and control: issues matched of 154 and 147; holdout: host / control matched of 102 and 119; study: the study's frozen pattern, before the narrowing that keeps the built-in kinds' runnable shapes with the lane

named-host.study: 11/3, holdout 2/2, before dropping `on a host` and `in Cursor`
